text: One-off: give existing grey sub-trees branch colors
description: New sub-ideas inherit their parent's color (±5% HSV, random hue below grey parents), but most existing ideas are #666666 because drag-create and MCP create_idea used to skip the parent. A one-off pass (top-down, same deriveChildIdeaColor) would color existing branches. Must leave user-picked colors alone and only touch ideas still at the default grey; per project, on request.
